description: This file defines structures, functions, and interfaces for managing Multiple Masters and GX variable fonts in the FreeType project. It includes data structures for axes, styles, and font variations, as well as functions to retrieve and set design coordinates and variations.

methods.name: FT_Get_Multi_Master
methods.description: Retrieves the Multiple Master descriptor of a given font.

methods.name: FT_Get_MM_Var
methods.description: Retrieves the Multiple Master / GX variable descriptor of a font.

methods.name: FT_Set_MM_Design_Coordinates
methods.description: Sets the design coordinates for Multiple Masters fonts.

methods.name: FT_Set_Var_Design_Coordinates
methods.description: Sets the design coordinates for Multiple Master or GX variable fonts.

methods.name: FT_Set_MM_Blend_Coordinates
methods.description: Sets normalized blend coordinates for Multiple Masters and GX variable fonts.
